segments.tha-ap548:2.3: Kataññū katavedī ca, titthe yojeti pāṇine [pāṇino (sī. syā pī.)].
segments.tha-ap548:10.3: Suṇitvā madhuraṃ dhammaṃ, kāraṃ katvā ca tādino.
segments.tha-ap548:11.3: ‘Kulappasādakānaggo, yo tayā santhuto [yo tava sāsane (syā.)] mune.
segments.tha-ap548:12.1: “‘Tādiso homahaṃ vīra [tādisohaṃ mahāvīra (syā. ka.)], buddhaseṭṭhassa sāsane’;
segments.tha-ap548:12.3: Tadā mahākāruṇiko, siñcanto vā matena maṃ.
segments.tha-ap548:13.3: Kathaṃ nāma jine kāraṃ, katvāna viphalo siyā.
segments.tha-ap548:14.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.
segments.tha-ap548:15.3: Udāyi nāma nāmena, hessati satthu sāvako’.
segments.tha-ap548:16.1: “Taṃ sutvā mudito hutvā, yāvajīvaṃ tadā jinaṃ;
segments.tha-ap548:23.3: Tato vinesi bhagavā, gantvā gantvā tahiṃ tahiṃ.
segments.tha-ap548:24.3: Upecca magadhe giriṃ [māgadagiriṃ (sī.), maṅgalāgiriṃ (pī.)], viharittha tadā jino.
segments.tha-ap548:27.1: “Jino tasmiṃ guṇe tuṭṭho, maṃ mahāparisāya so [mamāha purisāsabho (syā. pī.)];
segments.tha-ap548:29.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap548:31.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā kāḷudāyithero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: Thero pattaetadaggaṭṭhāno attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento padumuttaro nāma jinotiādigāthāyo abhāsi.
Guṇāguṇavidūti guṇañca aguṇañca guṇāguṇaṃ, vaṇṇāvaṇṇaṃ, kusalākusalaṃ vā taṃ jānātīti guṇāguṇavidū.
Kataññūti aññehi kataguṇaṃ jānātīti kataññū, ekadivasampi bhattadānādinā katūpakārassa rajjampi dātuṃ samatthattā kataññū.
Titthe yojeti pāṇineti sabbasatte nibbānapavesanupāye kusalapathe magge dhammadesanāya yojeti sampayojeti patiṭṭhāpetīti attho.
